comment.body: This assigned FancyZones tracker should use the shared haptics behavior from #50162 for parent #48761. Please trigger one Hover pulse only when the semantic candidate zone changes, suppress repeats while the candidate remains the same, and keep screen-edge Collide feedback out of scope as specified in the issue.

judgment.rationale: The maintainer-authored issue is already assigned and has precise implementation scope within the known haptics feature set.
evidence: The issue is authored and assigned to niels9001.
It references open parent #48761 and shared infrastructure #50162.
The scope explicitly uses candidate-zone changes, suppresses repeated feedback in one zone, and excludes screen-edge Collide behavior.
judgment.recommended_action: Post a scope note preserving semantic zone transitions and the shared haptics dependency.
